label: Remuneration threshold for high income earners
context: An employee who earns this much or more a year does not have certain dismissal protections, unless they and their employer agree in writing to opt back in. The threshold is reviewed each July and changes only if average ordinary weekly earnings rise.

label: End of the transition period for high income earners
context: An employee dismissed before this date who meets the conditions can still raise a personal grievance for unjustified dismissal. The change came into law on 21 February 2026, with a 12-month transition period.

label: Time to raise a personal grievance in the transition period
context: During the transition period, an eligible high income earner must raise the personal grievance within this many days of the dismissal date.

subject_intro: How redundancy works in New Zealand, from when a role can be cut to notice, final pay and compensation, and the different rules for high income earners.
